# On-demand pyrefly with a synced venv. Manual only: no github trigger, so it
# never runs on PRs or pushes and is not a required status.
#   rwx run .rwx/pyrefly.yml --wait
#   rwx run .rwx/pyrefly.yml --wait --init paths="app/foo.py app/bar.py"
# `rwx run` layers the local working tree (incl. uncommitted/untracked files)
# on the clone; HEAD must be pushed so `commit-sha` resolves.
on:
  cli:
    init:
      commit-sha: ${{ event.git.sha }}
      paths: ""

base:
  image: ubuntu:24.04
  config: rwx/base 1.2.0

tasks:
  - key: code
    call: git/clone 2.2.0
    with:
      repository: https://github.com/elviskahoro/buridan-ui.git
      ref: ${{ init.commit-sha }}

  # Checksum-pinned uv installer: fails closed if the script at the versioned
  # URL ever changes. No packaged uv/install leaf exists in the RWX catalog.
  - key: uv-install
    run: |
      set -euo pipefail
      script="$(mktemp)"
      trap 'rm -f "${script}"' EXIT
      curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/0.11.29/install.sh -o "${script}"
      echo "504a79fd2ed0dcd47e7f04f0792cfd0871f62e24a7fe40fa8ae0f563a369f2bd  ${script}" | sha256sum -c -
      sh "${script}"
      echo "$HOME/.local/bin" >> "$RWX_ENV/PATH"

  # Filtered to the lockfile inputs so this stays cached across ordinary
  # commits. --no-install-project: sources are outside the filter; `uv run`
  # installs the project itself.
  - key: deps
    use: [uv-install, code]
    filter:
      - pyproject.toml
      - uv.lock
      - .python-version
    run: uv sync --frozen --no-install-project --group dev

  # pyrefly is pinned to the Trunk version (not in the dev group). Installed in
  # its own task, with no dependency on `code`, so it is cached across runs
  # regardless of source changes. 
  - key: pyrefly-install
    use: uv-install
    run: |
      set -euo pipefail
      uv tool install pyrefly==1.3.1
      pyrefly --version

  - key: pyrefly
    use: [code, deps, pyrefly-install]
    cache: false
    env:
      CHECK_PATHS: ${{ init.paths }}
    run: |
      set -euo pipefail
      if [ -n "${CHECK_PATHS}" ]; then
        # shellcheck disable=SC2086
        pyrefly check ${CHECK_PATHS}
      else
        pyrefly check
      fi
# On-demand pyright with a synced venv. Manual only: no github trigger, so it
# never runs on PRs or pushes and is not a required status.
#   rwx run .rwx/pyright.yml --wait
#   rwx run .rwx/pyright.yml --wait --init paths="app/foo.py app/bar.py"
# `rwx run` layers the local working tree (incl. uncommitted/untracked files)
# on the clone; HEAD must be pushed so `commit-sha` resolves.
on:
  cli:
    init:
      commit-sha: ${{ event.git.sha }}
      paths: ""

base:
  image: ubuntu:24.04
  config: rwx/base 1.2.0

tasks:
  - key: code
    call: git/clone 2.2.0
    with:
      repository: https://github.com/elviskahoro/buridan-ui.git
      ref: ${{ init.commit-sha }}

  # Checksum-pinned uv installer: fails closed if the script at the versioned
  # URL ever changes. No packaged uv/install leaf exists in the RWX catalog.
  - key: uv-install
    run: |
      set -euo pipefail
      script="$(mktemp)"
      trap 'rm -f "${script}"' EXIT
      curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/0.11.29/install.sh -o "${script}"
      echo "504a79fd2ed0dcd47e7f04f0792cfd0871f62e24a7fe40fa8ae0f563a369f2bd  ${script}" | sha256sum -c -
      sh "${script}"
      echo "$HOME/.local/bin" >> "$RWX_ENV/PATH"

  # Filtered to the lockfile inputs so this stays cached across ordinary
  # commits. --no-install-project: sources are outside the filter; `uv run`
  # installs the project itself.
  - key: deps
    use: [uv-install, code]
    filter:
      - pyproject.toml
      - uv.lock
      - .python-version
    run: uv sync --frozen --no-install-project --group dev

  # pyright is pinned to the Trunk version (not in the dev group). Installed in
  # its own task, with no dependency on `code`, so it is cached across runs
  # regardless of source changes. The version call also fetches the node runtime pyright needs, so that is cached too.
  - key: pyright-install
    use: uv-install
    run: |
      set -euo pipefail
      uv tool install pyright==1.1.414
      pyright --version

  - key: pyright
    use: [code, deps, pyright-install]
    cache: false
    env:
      CHECK_PATHS: ${{ init.paths }}
    run: |
      set -euo pipefail
      # shellcheck disable=SC2086
      pyright --pythonpath .venv/bin/python --project pyrightconfig.json ${CHECK_PATHS}
----
on:
  github:
    push:
      init:
        commit-sha: ${{ event.git.sha }}
        branch: ${{ event.git.branch }}
        repository: https://github.com/elviskahoro/reflex-starter-template.git
        event-type: push
        before-sha: ${{ event.github.push.before }}
      if: ${{ event.git.branch == 'main' || event.git.branch == 'trunk-merge/**' }}
      # Custom status check so merge.required_statuses (.trunk/trunk.yaml)
      # can require this task by a name that posts identically on PR heads
      # and trunk-merge/** batch refs; the default per-run status renames
      # itself per trigger. See .rwx/trunk-check.yml for the full rationale.
      status-checks:
        - tasks: [pytest]
          name: pytest
    pull_request:
      init:
        commit-sha: ${{ event.git.sha }}
        repository: https://github.com/elviskahoro/reflex-starter-template.git
        event-type: pull_request
        base-sha: ${{ event.github.pull_request.pull_request.base.sha }}
      if: ${{ event.github.pull_request.pull_request.base.ref == 'main' }}
      # Same stable name as the push trigger above.
      status-checks:
        - tasks: [pytest]
          name: pytest
  cli:
    init:
      commit-sha: ${{ event.git.sha }}
      branch: ${{ event.git.branch }}
      repository: https://github.com/elviskahoro/reflex-starter-template.git
      event-type: push
      before-sha: ""

base:
  image: ubuntu:24.04
  config: rwx/base 1.2.0

tasks:
  - key: code
    call: git/clone 2.2.0
    with:
      repository: ${{ init.repository }}
      ref: ${{ init.commit-sha }}
      fetch-full-depth: true
      preserve-git-dir: true

  - key: uv-install
    run: |
      set -euo pipefail
      script="$(mktemp)"
      trap 'rm -f "${script}"' EXIT
      curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/0.11.13/install.sh -o "${script}"
      echo "48cd5aca5d5671a3b3d5f61538cc8622e4434af63319115159990d8b0dd02416  ${script}" | sha256sum -c -
      sh "${script}"
      echo "$HOME/.local/bin" >> $RWX_ENV/PATH

  - key: deps
    use: [code, uv-install]
    filter:
      - pyproject.toml
      - uv.lock
    run: |
      uv sync --frozen --group dev
      echo "$PWD/.venv/bin" >> $RWX_ENV/PATH
      echo "VIRTUAL_ENV=$PWD/.venv" >> $RWX_ENV/VIRTUAL_ENV

  - key: pytest
    use: [code, deps]
    run: uv run pytest -q

content.text:
I copied `pyright.yml` and `pyrefly.yml` from `elviskahoro/buridan-ui` into `.rwx/` here. I haven't run either pipeline or committed anything.

Both are manual-only, with no GitHub trigger. You run them with `rwx run .rwx/pyright.yml --wait` or `rwx run .rwx/pyrefly.yml --wait`. You can pass `--init paths="..."` to check specific files.

I made two changes from the originals:
- **Repository:** the clone now points at `elviskahoro/reflex-starter-template` instead of buridan-ui.
- **Example paths:** the example in the usage comments is `web/foo.py web/bar.py` instead of `app/...`.

Everything else is as it was, including the pinned tool versions (pyright 1.1.414, pyrefly 1.3.1) and the uv 0.11.29 installer checksum. Those versions match this repo's `pyproject.toml`.

The `deps` task in each file filters on `.python-version`, which this repo doesn't have. I left it in. The filter should just match nothing, but I haven't confirmed that RWX accepts it.

`rwx run` needs `HEAD` pushed so `commit-sha` resolves. This branch will need pushing before the pipelines will run.
